description_en: Queries the execution result of Spark code
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-spark-code-output --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-uf6210mmev070000 --job-id 620 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSparkCodeOutput

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html接口查询目标地域下集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Spark job
parameters.name: job_id

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Success is returned.
If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh:
调用结果的附加信息。取值说明：
请求正常，返回Success。 
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Output.description_en: The execution result, which is in the format of JSON objects
Output.description_zh: 执行的输出，为JSON对象格式

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。
true：成功。
false：失败
